newsitem.title: USA: Engle Homes Q2 home sales revs up.
newsitem.headline: Engle Homes Q2 home sales revs up.

text.p: Engle Homes Inc said Wednesday that revenues from the sale of homes increased 49 percent to $96.7 million in the second quarter ended April 30, 1997 versus $64.8 million in the comparable quarter.
The company said these numbers are based on the sale of 466 homes, up from 333.

The company said the value of new home sales contracts decreased 10 percent during the second quarter of fiscal 1997 to $110.7 million compared with $123.1 million in contracts in the comparable quarter.

The reduction in new home sales contracts for the comparable quarter resulted primarily from record results in the second quarter in fiscal 1996, when new orders increased 65 percent, the company said.
